conceptZh: 厚實的玩具戰鬥機器人騎上迷你木馬，才剛擺出英雄姿勢，木馬輕輕一搖，就讓它忙著抱緊馬脖子。
object: A chunky toy battle robot and a comically tiny wooden rocking horse.
morph: A gentle optical dissolve replaces the centered toy tableau with a correctly typeset 馬; the glyph remains rigid and unchanged.
creativeAngle: 用大機器人與小木馬的尺寸反差製造笑點：威風姿勢被一次小搖晃打斷。以完整字形淡入取代拆件拼字，保留清楚筆畫與四個底點。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D toy animation in a locked, front-facing composition against a light warm cream background. Use bright, non-neon colors, soft shadows, and exclusively visibly animated toys. Keep the teaching subject centered and fully uncropped throughout.

At the opening, a chunky cobalt toy battle robot with obvious mechanical joints carefully lowers itself onto a comically tiny wooden rocking horse. Give the horse a clearly recognizable muzzle, mane, tail, four short legs, and curved wooden rockers. By 1.5 seconds, the robot sits proudly upright and raises one fist in a heroic pose. Allow a brief motionless anticipation pause. At 2.2 seconds, the horse makes one gentle forward-and-back rock. The robot's raised arm comically pinwheels once, then both oversized hands clasp the tiny horse's neck as its hinged feet stick straight forward. Its round illuminated eyes widen; the horse settles safely upright. Let this single harmless payoff read until 3.5 seconds, accompanied by a quiet wooden creak.

From 3.5 to 4.2 seconds, softly dissolve the entire toy tableau into one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 馬, using a verified Traditional Chinese typeface with clear stroke separation and four distinct bottom dots. The toys disappear completely. Render the glyph in saturated solid cobalt, centered at approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. From 4.2 seconds through the end at exactly 8 seconds, hold the completed glyph perfectly still, fully unobstructed, with no camera movement or additional animation.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin. The ONLY spoken line is exactly "馬、馬、木馬". Speak the first 馬 around 0.6 seconds, the second around 1.7 seconds, and 木馬 naturally around 5.2–6.2 seconds, while the completed glyph is clearly visible. Pronunciation directions: 馬 = ㄇㄚˇ, pinyin mǎ; 木馬 = ㄇㄨˋ ㄇㄚˇ, pinyin mù mǎ. Both isolated readings and the 馬 syllable in 木馬 use the same mǎ reading. Bopomofo and pinyin are silent pronunciation directions, never spoken or displayed. Stop speaking after 木馬. Use no background music. The vocabulary is audio only: the single target glyph 馬 is the only on-screen text, with no subtitles, logos, written names, watermark, clutter, or flashing effects.
direction:

Theme: A chunky toy battle robot mounts a tiny rocking horse; its proud heroic pose is undone by a gentle wobble. Use clearly stylized toys or cartoon animals; costume characters must be obviously toy/robot figures. Keep the character itself and its meaning central; the prop gag is brief and the final glyph remains correct, unobstructed, large and still for at least 3 seconds. No logos or written character names on screen.
PRONUNCIATION LOCK: target 馬, Bopomofo ㄇㄚˇ, Mandarin pinyin mǎ. The ONLY spoken line must be exactly "馬、馬、木馬". Example word is fixed as 木馬, pronounced mù mǎ. Do not substitute a word. Both isolated readings and the target syllable inside the word must have exactly the same reading. Include this exact spoken line and these pronunciation guides explicitly in promptEn, stating that Bopomofo/pinyin are silent pronunciation directions, never spoken or displayed. Use clear Taiwanese Mandarin, no extra dialogue, no character catchphrases. Avoid other polyphonic examples or reading alternatives anywhere in the narration instructions. Themes affect the visual gag only, never the spoken vocabulary.

conceptZh: 「馬」字像小馬踏步，頑皮水管把消防車變成被牽著走的小車；消防隊本想拉馬，反而被輕輕拉起前輪。
object: A solid vermilion 馬 sculpture, a chunky toy fire engine, its toy firefighter crew, and a mischievous hose.
morph: Animate the complete, correctly formed glyph as one rigid prancing sculpture. Its four distinct bottom dots suggest hoofbeats without separating or changing any strokes; it settles into the final static teaching pose.
creativeAngle: 直接讓完整的「馬」字演出馬拉車：消防隊用力拉不動，字只踏一步，消防車就翹起前輪。四個底點呼應蹄聲，全程保留正確字形，最後收走水管與消防車。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D animation with a locked frontal camera, a pale warm cream background, soft shadows, and bright, non-neon toy colors. Center one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 馬, rendered as a shallow solid vermilion sculpture using accurate Traditional Chinese textbook typography. Its complete silhouette, including all four distinct bottom dots and the right-hand hooked stroke, must remain readable and uncropped. The finished glyph occupies approximately 70% of frame height with comfortable margins. Animate the entire glyph as one rigid unit, preserving every stroke and gap.

The lead is an original chunky yellow toy fire engine with an eager personality, expressive windshield eyes, two small molded-plastic firefighter figures seated securely in its cab, and a lively blue hose that acts on its own. All cast members are unmistakably stylized animated toys with unmarked surfaces and original designs. Place the engine below and slightly to the right of the centered glyph, clear of its silhouette. No additional props are needed.

Begin with the engine confidently bracing its wheels while its mischievous hose reaches behind the glyph and gently catches its rear surface like a loose rein, leaving the frontal strokes exposed. By 1.2 seconds, the crew lean backward together, trying to lead their enormous letter-horse; the engine's wheels turn once without moving it. The glyph stays stubbornly still. Pause briefly so the effort reads.

At 2.1 seconds, 馬 gives one proud, compact prancing hop as a complete rigid shape. A soft horse snort and four quick, quiet hoof taps establish its horse personality, with the four bottom dots visually suggesting hooves. The little tug through the hose rolls the engine forward and gently lifts its front wheels into one exaggerated miniature wheelie. The crew's hinged arms pop upward together; the engine's confident eyes become wide circles. Hold this harmless surprise for a brief beat, then let all wheels land softly by 3.2 seconds. The crew sit upright, exchange a quick look, and give a synchronized satisfied nod as though their unexpected ride was intentional.

The hose politely releases and curls back onto the engine. The engine rolls out through the lower-right margin while 馬 settles exactly into its centered teaching position. Finish all motion by 4.6 seconds. From 4.6 through exactly 8.0 seconds, hold only the complete saturated vermilion 馬 perfectly still and unobstructed at approximately 70% of frame height. Preserve crisp edges, open interior spaces, four clearly separated bottom dots, and the correct hook.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin. The exact and only spoken line is 「馬、馬、馬車」. Say the first 馬 around 0.4–0.9 seconds, the second around 1.3–1.8 seconds, and 馬車 naturally around 5.3–6.3 seconds, with the finished glyph clearly visible throughout the word. Pronounce 馬 as ㄇㄚˇ and 馬車 as ㄇㄚˇ ㄔㄜ. Stop speaking after 馬車. Keep the toy rolling sounds, horse snort, and hoof taps gentle and below the voice; use no background music. The vocabulary is audio only. 馬 is the sole on-screen text: no subtitles, labels, logos, watermark, unrelated text, clutter, or flashing effects.
